verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. LORD, the king celebrates your strength! He's overjoyed because you saved him.
You gave him what his heart wanted. You didn't hold back what he asked for. Selah.
You came to meet him with good blessings and put a crown of pure gold on his head. 👑
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, days that stretch on forever and ever.
Your rescue brought him great glory. You gave him honor and majesty.
You bless him forever and fill him with joy in your presence.
The king trusts in the LORD. The faithful love of the Most High keeps him steady.
Your hand will find every enemy. Your right hand will find everyone who hates you.
When your anger flares, you'll make them like a blazing furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in his anger. Fire will consume them.
You'll wipe their descendants off the earth and their family line from humanity.
They meant to hurt you. They came up with a scheme that can't work.
You'll send them running when you aim your drawn bows right at them.
Rise high in your strength, LORD! We'll sing and praise your power. 🎶
